n37ae3e4fc35.s: Which body is India's nodal agency for the International Comparison Programme (ICP)?
o: Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT
n37ae3e4fc35.x: The NSO, which follows IMF-SDDS norms, is India's nodal agency for the ICP.

n2d710a2e90b.s: Which base year of India's National Accounts immediately followed 1993-94?
n2d710a2e90b.x: The sequence runs 1980-81, 1993-94, 1999-2000, 2004-05; 2009-10 was never a base year.

n6e2c3d943d1.s: The new Consumer Price Index (CPI) series has the base year:
n6e2c3d943d1.x: The CPI was rebased to 2024 from the calendar year 2012; it is the IIP, not the CPI, that moved to 2022-23.

n1a8790c474d.s: From 2025, the PLFS provides all-India labour estimates at what frequency?
n1a8790c474d.x: PLFS 2025 provides monthly all-India estimates, not only annual ones.

nbe6d74cde30.s: In 2014-15, the private corporate sector's share of India's GVA was:
nbe6d74cde30.x: The private corporate sector accounted for 35.9% of GVA in 2014-15; 44.8% was the household sector's share that year.

na9eb5b8ef86.s: Which group consists only of States/UTs stated to have crossed the upper-middle-income threshold?
na9eb5b8ef86.x: Karnataka, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, Gujarat and Delhi crossed the threshold; Kerala is not in the list.

n5465195da58.s: PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan is built on how many engines?
n5465195da58.x: Its seven engines are roads, railways, airports, ports, mass transport, waterways and logistics infrastructure.

n4c99efe7ec9.s: Which of the following phases of India's population growth is NOT correctly matched?
n4c99efe7ec9.x: 1921-51 was a phase of steady growth; rapid growth came in 1951-81.

new.s: William Digby estimated India's per capita income for 1899 at:
new.x: Digby's estimate for 1899 gave a per capita income of Rs 18; Rs 20 was Naoroji's figure.

new.s: Findlay Shirras's 1911 estimate put India's per capita income at:
new.x: Findlay Shirras estimated per capita income at Rs 49 in 1911.

new.s: The CSO published the first official national income estimates (conventional series, base 1948-49) in:
new.x: The CSO's first official estimates came in 1956; 1949 was the year the National Income Committee was set up and 1951 its first report.

new.s: The National Income Committee's first report put India's per capita income for 1948-49 at:
new.x: The 1951 report gave PCI of Rs 225; Rs 8,710 crore was the national income.

new.s: The head of the National Statistical Office (NSO) is the:
new.x: The Chief Statistician of India heads the NSO and is also Secretary, MoSPI.

new.s: The Central Statistical Organisation (CSO) was formed on:
new.x: The CSO was formed on 2 May 1951; it merged with the NSSO in 2019 to form the NSO.

new.s: The Wholesale Price Index (WPI) in India is compiled by the:
o: Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT
new.x: WPI is compiled by the Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT, not the NSO.

new.s: Data on capital formation in India are released by:
new.x: Capital formation estimates come from the RBI and the NSO.

new.s: The Index of Industrial Production (IIP) covers which sectors?
new.x: The IIP covers mining, manufacturing and electricity.

new.s: Which of the following was never a base year of India's national accounts?
new.x: 2009-10 was never a base year; the others are part of the sequence.

new.s: Counting up to the 2022-23 series, how many base years have India's National Accounts Statistics had?
new.x: The nine base years run from 1948-49 to 2022-23.

new.s: Under the 2011-12 series, which corporate database partly replaced the ASI for estimating the corporate sector?
new.x: The MCA-21 company database (1,35,802 companies) partly replaced the ASI (67,649 factories).

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the 2022-23 national accounts series:
1. It uses double deflation and Supply and Use Tables.
2. Private final consumption is benchmarked on HCES 2022-23.
3. It revised 2023-24 growth upward from 7.2% to 9.2%.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; 2023-24 growth was revised down from 9.2% to 7.2%.

new.s: In the 2022-23 series, the nominal GDP of 2022-23 was revised from Rs 269 lakh crore to:
new.x: The new series cut 2022-23 nominal GDP from Rs 269 to Rs 261 lakh crore, a cut of 3-4%.

new.s: The Second Advance Estimate (SAE) of national income is released at the end of:
new.x: The SAE comes at the end of February, after the FAE in early January.

new.s: Quarterly GDP estimates are compiled mainly from:
o: Annual Survey of Industries results alone
new.x: Quarterly GDP uses high-frequency indicators and GST data and comes about two months after the quarter.

new.s: AP's 2023-24 livestock growth was +4.79% at the Advance Estimate. At the First Revised Estimate it was:
new.x: It fell to −0.51% at the FRE, which is why the estimate stage must always be quoted.

new.s: Which NSO survey provides CPI weights and the benchmark for private final consumption?
new.x: The Household Consumption Expenditure Survey (HCES) gives CPI weights and the PFCE benchmark.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: ASI covers registered factories; PLFS measures employment, ASUSE unincorporated enterprises and TUS time use.

new.s: The K.N. Raj Committee (1981) is associated with estimates of:
new.x: The K.N. Raj Committee (1981) relates to saving and capital formation estimates.

new.s: As per NAS 2025, household saving as a share of GDP in 2023-24 was:
new.x: Household saving fell from 18.6% (2022-23) to 18.1% of GDP (2023-24).

new.s: The first full Household Consumption Expenditure Survey since 2011-12 relates to:
new.x: HCES 2022-23 is the first full survey since 2011-12; the 2017-18 survey was withheld.

new.s: Population enumeration for India's delayed Census is scheduled from:
new.x: Houselisting runs April-September 2026 and population enumeration begins in February 2027.

new.s: The 2025-26 First Advance Estimate of Andhra Pradesh's GSDP is about:
new.x: The DES, AP placed the 2025-26 FAE of GSDP at Rs 17.62 lakh crore.

new.s: Per capita income is calculated as:
new.x: Per capita income equals national income divided by population.

new.s: India's per capita national income for 2025-26 (FAE, current prices) was:
new.x: The FAE (January 2026) put per capita national income at ₹2,47,487.

new.s: In 2025-26 (FAE), per capita national income rose over the previous year by about:
new.x: PCI rose by ₹16,025 over the previous year to ₹2,47,487.

new.s: Which of the following is cited as a reason for the slow growth of India's per capita income?
new.x: Population growth, low farm productivity and a large unorganised sector slow PCI growth.

new.s: Per capita income grows more slowly at constant prices than at current prices because constant-price figures:
new.x: Constant prices strip out inflation, so PCI rises faster at current prices.

new.s: Economic Survey 2025-26 was prepared under Chief Economic Adviser:
new.x: Economic Survey 2025-26, tabled on 29 January 2026, came under CEA V. Anantha Nageswaran.

new.s: Economic Survey 2025-26 projected India's FY27 real GDP growth at:
new.x: The Survey projected FY27 growth at 6.8-7.2%.

new.s: Economic Survey 2025-26 described FY27 as a:
new.x: The Survey called FY27 a 'year of adjustment'.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Economic Survey 2025-26:
1. It was tabled on 29 January 2026.
2. It raised India's potential growth estimate to 7%.
3. It reported bank gross NPAs at a multi-decade high.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; bank GNPA at 2.2% was a multi-decade low.

new.s: India's public capital expenditure in FY26 was about what share of GDP?
new.x: Public capex, a key growth driver, was 3.1% of GDP in FY26.

new.s: Private consumption, cited as a driver of India's growth outlook, is measured as:
new.x: Private Final Consumption Expenditure (PFCE) is the private consumption driver.

new.s: India's current account deficit in 2024-25 was about what share of GDP?
new.x: The CAD was 0.6% of GDP in 2024-25; 0.8% was for H1 FY26.

new.s: The Union fiscal deficit for FY27 (BE) is:
new.x: The fiscal deficit falls from 4.8% (FY25) and 4.4% (FY26) to 4.3% in FY27 BE.

new.s: The IMF (Nov 2025) now expects India to become a USD 5 trillion economy in:
new.x: IMF expects it in FY29 (2028-29), a year later than earlier, mainly due to a weak rupee.

new.s: Viksit Bharat @2047 aims to make India a developed nation by the ____ year of Independence.
new.x: 2047 marks the 100th year of Independence.

new.s: Which State had the largest economy by GSDP in 2024-25?
new.x: Maharashtra ranked 1st by GSDP, followed by Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Gujarat.

new.s: Among the four largest State economies, which grew fastest since 2021-22?
new.x: Karnataka grew fastest (about 65%); Maharashtra grew slowest of the big four.

new.s: According to the EAC-PM report (Sep 2024), Telangana's share of national GDP in 2023-24 was:
new.x: Telangana's share rose from 3.8% (2010-11) to 4.9%; AP's was about 4.7%.

new.s: Per the EAC-PM report, Andhra Pradesh's per capita income in 2023-24 was what % of the national average?
new.x: AP's relative PCI was 131.6%; 193.6% was Telangana's.

new.s: As per the 2025-26 FAE, Andhra Pradesh's per capita income is about how many times India's?
new.x: AP's PCI is about 1.34 times the all-India figure.

new.s: Swarna Andhra @2047 targets an Andhra Pradesh GSDP of about:
new.x: The vision targets a GSDP of USD 2.4 trillion (about ₹308 lakh crore) by 2047.

new.s: Swarna Andhra @2047 targets a per capita income for Andhra Pradesh of about:
new.x: The target PCI is about USD 42,000 (₹55 lakh) by 2047.

new.s: The annual growth rate targeted under Swarna Andhra @2047 is:
new.x: The vision aims at 15% growth a year, built on the Ten Guiding Principles (P4 Padi Sutralu).

new.s: Advance estimates of India's GDP are released by the:
new.x: Advance and quarterly estimates come from the NSO under MoSPI, not the RBI.

new.s: The World Bank's Global Economic Prospects is released in:
new.x: Global Economic Prospects is issued twice a year, in January and June.

new.s: Which institutional sector is the largest contributor to India's GVA?
new.x: The largely unorganised household sector is largest (45.5% in 2011-12), ahead of private corporates.

new.s: As per Census 2011, the number of agricultural labourers in India was about:
new.x: Agricultural labourers numbered 14.4 crore, more than the 11.9 crore cultivators.

new.s: Cultivators in India declined from 12.7 crore in 2001 to ____ in 2011.
new.x: Cultivators fell to 11.9 crore (about 24.6%) as agricultural labourers rose to 14.4 crore.

new.s: According to NFHS-5 (2019-21), India's overall sex ratio was:
new.x: NFHS-5 recorded 1,020 (NFHS-4: 991), the first time more women than men; 943 is Census 2011.

new.s: NFHS-5 reported India's sex ratio at birth as:
new.x: Sex ratio at birth rose to 929 from 919 in NFHS-5.

new.s: As per Census 2011, what share of ST households used electricity as the main source of lighting?
new.x: 52% of ST households used electricity, against 59% of SC and 67% of all households.

new.s: As per Census 2011, the share of ST households with a latrine within premises was:
new.x: Only 23% of ST households had a latrine, against 34% for SC and 47% for all households.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Census 2011 household amenities:
1. ST households lagged SC households in electricity as the main lighting source.
2. SC households had higher latrine access than the all-India average.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is correct (52% vs 59%); SC latrine access was 34%, below the all-India 47%.

new.s: Census 2011 was India's ____ national Census.
new.x: Census 2011 was the 15th national Census, with the motto 'Our Census, Our Future'.

new.s: The mascots of Census 2027 are:
new.x: Census 2027's mascots are Pragati and Vikas.

new.s: India's final child sex ratio (0-6 years) in Census 2011 was:
new.x: The final child sex ratio was 919; 914 was the provisional figure and 927 the 2001 figure.

new.s: India's rural sex ratio in Census 2011 was:
new.x: The rural sex ratio was 949 and the urban 929; overall 943.

new.s: The share of Hindus in India's population fell from 84.1% in 1951 to ____ in 2011.
new.x: Hindus formed 79.8% in 2011, down from 84.1% in 1951.

new.s: As per the final Census 2011 figures, the State with the lowest female literacy was:
new.x: Bihar had the lowest final female literacy (51.5%); Rajasthan was lowest only in provisional figures.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's decadal population growth during 2001-11 was:
new.x: AP grew 9.21% in 2001-11 against India's 17.7%.

new.s: The sex ratio of Scheduled Tribes in Andhra Pradesh (Census 2011) was:
new.x: AP's ST sex ratio was 1,009; 997 was AP's overall sex ratio and 990 India's ST sex ratio.

new.s: India's share of the world population is about:
new.x: India accounts for about 17.5% of the world population, not 18.5%.
